examples.en: We verified that the compact singular value decomposition reconstructed the rank-deficient example exactly after dropping its zero terms.
examples.zh: 去掉零奇异值所对应项后，我们验证「紧致奇异值分解」仍精确重建了这个秩亏的示例。

collocations: compute a compact singular value decomposition
store the factors of a compact singular value decomposition
reconstruct a matrix from a compact singular value decomposition

words.enDefinition: approximating a matrix by keeping only a selected number of its largest singular values and corresponding directions

examples.en: The truncated singular value decomposition kept just the three strongest directions to approximate the original classroom data matrix.
examples.zh: 「截断奇异值分解」只保留三个最强方向来近似原课堂数据矩阵。

examples.en: We increased the rank of the truncated singular value decomposition to see how much the approximation error fell.
examples.zh: 我们提高「截断奇异值分解」保留的秩，查看近似误差减小多少。

collocations: compute a truncated singular value decomposition
choose the rank for a truncated singular value decomposition

words.enDefinition: the unique generalized inverse satisfying the four Penrose identities, computed from a singular value decomposition by reciprocating nonzero singular values

examples.en: The Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse supplied a coefficient vector for a rectangular matrix with no ordinary inverse.
examples.zh: 尽管课堂矩阵为矩形、没有普通逆矩阵，「摩尔彭若斯伪逆」仍给出了一个系数向量。

examples.en: We used the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse to find the solution of smallest norm among all least-squares solutions.
examples.zh: 我们用「摩尔彭若斯伪逆」求所有最小二乘解中范数最小的一个。

collocations: check identities for the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse

words.enDefinition: a replacement of a matrix by a lower-rank matrix chosen to preserve important structure and limit a stated error

examples.en: The example used a low-rank approximation so the chart could be reconstructed from fewer stored values.
examples.zh: 示例用「低秩近似」，让图表可由较少存储值重建。

examples.en: We compared two versions of a low-rank approximation after measuring errors in their reconstructed matrices.
examples.zh: 我们衡量重建矩阵的误差后，比较了两个版本的「低秩近似」。

collocations: measure error in a low-rank approximation
choose the rank of a low-rank approximation

words.enDefinition: the result that truncating a singular value decomposition to the k largest singular values gives a best rank-at-most-k approximation in the spectral and Frobenius norms

examples.en: The Eckart-Young theorem justified keeping the largest singular values in our approximation of the sample matrix.
examples.zh: 「埃卡特扬定理」说明近似样本矩阵时，保留最大的奇异值是有依据的。

examples.en: The tutor applied the Eckart-Young theorem to compare the truncation error with every possible rank-two approximation.
examples.zh: 导师用「埃卡特扬定理」比较截断误差与所有可能的秩二近似误差。

collocations: justify a truncation using the Eckart-Young theorem

words.enDefinition: the square root of the sum of the squared magnitudes of all entries of a matrix

examples.en: We used the Frobenius norm to measure the total size of the entrywise errors in our approximation.
examples.zh: 我们用「弗罗贝尼乌斯范数」衡量近似在各个矩阵元素上的总体误差大小。

examples.en: The tutor calculated the Frobenius norm from the singular values as a check on the entry calculation.
examples.zh: 导师用各奇异值计算「弗罗贝尼乌斯范数」，用来核验按矩阵元素得到的结果。

collocations: bound error in the Frobenius norm

words.enDefinition: the maximum Euclidean norm of a matrix's output over all input vectors of Euclidean norm one

examples.en: The spectral norm measured the maximum stretching of any unit vector by the rectangular matrix in class.
examples.zh: 「谱范数」衡量课堂中的矩形矩阵对任意单位向量可产生的最大拉伸倍数。

examples.en: We used the largest singular value to check our calculation of the spectral norm in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用最大奇异值核查练习中对「谱范数」的计算。

collocations: bound an error in the spectral norm

words.enDefinition: a function assigning a nonnegative size to a matrix that satisfies the norm axioms on a matrix space

examples.en: The tutor specified a matrix norm before comparing two approximations of different entries in the same table.
examples.zh: 导师先指定一种「矩阵范数」，再比较对同一表格各元素的两种近似。

examples.en: We changed the matrix norm to emphasise the largest stretching effect instead of accumulated entrywise error.
examples.zh: 我们更换「矩阵范数」，着重考虑最大拉伸作用，而非各元素误差的累积。

collocations: compare bounds in two matrix norms

words.enDefinition: a measure of how sensitive a mathematical result is to small input perturbations, commonly expressed using relative changes

examples.en: The large condition number warned that rounding a measured entry could noticeably change the solution in this example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，较大的「条件数」提示，一个测量项的舍入就可能明显改变所求的解。

examples.en: We divided the largest singular value by the smallest to find the invertible matrix's spectral condition number.
examples.zh: 我们用该可逆矩阵的最大奇异值除以最小奇异值，算出谱范数意义下的「条件数」。

words.enDefinition: a matrix with a large condition number for the stated problem, so small perturbations can significantly affect results

examples.en: The ill-conditioned matrix produced noticeably different solutions after we rounded just one input number in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们只舍入一个输入数值，「病态矩阵」对应的解就有明显变化。

examples.en: We found nearly dependent columns before discussing why the classroom example was an ill-conditioned matrix for solving equations.
examples.zh: 我们先找出近乎线性相关的列，再讨论这个课堂示例在解方程时为何是「病态矩阵」。

collocations: solve a system with an ill-conditioned matrix

words.enDefinition: a matrix with a modest condition number for the specified problem, so small input changes need not cause large relative changes

examples.en: The well-conditioned matrix gave nearly the same solution after we slightly perturbed the measured right-hand side in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们轻微扰动测得的方程组右侧向量，「良态矩阵」对应的解仍几乎相同。

examples.en: We compared a well-conditioned matrix with one whose largest singular value was much greater than its smallest.
examples.zh: 我们把「良态矩阵」与另一个最大奇异值远大于最小奇异值的矩阵比较。

collocations: compare a well-conditioned matrix with an ill-conditioned one

words.enDefinition: the effective rank of a matrix under a stated tolerance, often counting singular values above that tolerance

examples.en: The numerical rank was two after the example treated the smallest singular value as effectively zero.
examples.zh: 示例将最小奇异值视为实际为零后，「数值秩」为二。

examples.en: We checked how the numerical rank changed when the tutor set a different tolerance for small singular values.
examples.zh: 导师为小奇异值设定不同容差后，我们核查了「数值秩」怎样变化。

collocations: use a tolerance to determine numerical rank
compare numerical rank with exact rank

words.enDefinition: a matrix approximation using a matrix of rank at most one

examples.en: The rank-one approximation kept only the most prominent pattern in the classroom table of measurements.
examples.zh: 「秩一近似」只保留课堂测量表里最明显的模式。

examples.en: We constructed the rank-one approximation from the largest singular value and its corresponding pair of vectors.
examples.zh: 我们根据最大奇异值和对应的一对向量构造「秩一近似」。

collocations: compare a rank-one approximation with the original matrix
measure the error of a rank-one approximation

words.enDefinition: a matrix of rank at most k minimising the distance to a given matrix in a stated norm

examples.en: The best rank-k approximation retained the largest singular values under the norm chosen for the assignment.
examples.zh: 在作业指定范数下，「最佳秩 k 近似」保留了最大的奇异值。

examples.en: We compared the best rank-k approximation with a simpler truncation that removed several entries directly.
examples.zh: 我们把「最佳秩 k 近似」与一种直接去掉若干元素的简单截断比较。

collocations: compute the error of a best rank-k approximation
find a best rank-k approximation in the spectral norm

words.enDefinition: an iterative method estimating a dominant eigenvector by repeatedly multiplying by the matrix and rescaling

examples.en: The power iteration gradually aligned the starting vector with the matrix's dominant eigenvector in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「幂迭代」逐渐使起始向量对准矩阵主特征向量的方向。

examples.en: We chose a starting vector for power iteration with a nonzero component along the dominant direction.
examples.zh: 我们为「幂迭代」选择了沿主方向有非零分量的起始向量。

collocations: choose an initial vector for power iteration

words.enDefinition: an eigenvector associated with an eigenvalue having the largest magnitude, typically unique in direction under a suitable assumption

examples.en: The dominant eigenvector indicated the direction approached by the normalised repeated products in our particular example.
examples.zh: 在我们的特定示例中，「主特征向量」指出反复相乘并归一化后趋近的方向。

examples.en: We checked the computed dominant eigenvector by multiplying it by the original matrix in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们用原矩阵乘求得的「主特征向量」来核查结果。

collocations: check the direction of a dominant eigenvector

words.enDefinition: an eigenvector estimation method repeatedly solving linear systems with a matrix, often after shifting that matrix

examples.en: The tutor applied inverse iteration with a shift close to the selected eigenvalue in the worked example.
examples.zh: 导师在例题中使用接近目标特征值的位移，并应用「逆迭代」。

examples.en: We compared inverse iteration with the earlier procedure that repeatedly multiplied by the original matrix directly.
examples.zh: 我们把「逆迭代」与之前直接反复乘以原矩阵的方法比较。

collocations: choose a shift for inverse iteration
approximate an eigenvector by inverse iteration

words.enDefinition: adding or subtracting a scalar multiple of the identity matrix to shift every eigenvalue by the same amount

examples.en: The eigenvalue shift moved the roots by the same amount while their corresponding eigenvectors stayed unchanged.
examples.zh: 「特征值平移」使各根移动同一个量，对应的特征向量保持不变。

examples.en: We used an eigenvalue shift before testing which mode the iteration would emphasise in the example.
examples.zh: 我们先作「特征值平移」，再试验迭代在该例中会突出哪一种模态。

collocations: check the effect of an eigenvalue shift

words.enDefinition: the theorem that every eigenvalue of a complex square matrix lies in at least one of its Gershgorin discs

examples.en: The Gershgorin circle theorem bounded all eigenvalues before we solved the characteristic equation for the sample matrix.
examples.zh: 对于样本矩阵，在求解特征方程之前，「盖尔施戈林圆盘定理」已给出所有特征值的范围。

examples.en: Our tutor used the Gershgorin circle theorem to narrow the region before drawing the calculated eigenvalues.
examples.zh: 导师在绘制所算出的特征值前，先用「盖尔施戈林圆盘定理」缩小它们所在的区域。

collocations: bound the spectrum with the Gershgorin circle theorem

words.enDefinition: a Gram-Schmidt variant updating each remaining vector with the current orthonormal direction before continuing, improving numerical behaviour in typical computations

examples.en: The tutor used the modified Gram-Schmidt process after the original method lost accuracy in the example's inner products.
examples.zh: 原方法在示例的内积计算中出现精度损失后，导师采用「修正格拉姆施密特法」。

examples.en: We compared the modified Gram-Schmidt process with the original method using a basis of nearly dependent vectors.
examples.zh: 我们用一组近乎线性相关的向量，比较「修正格拉姆施密特法」与原方法。

collocations: compare the modified Gram-Schmidt process with classical Gram-Schmidt
compute a factor using the modified Gram-Schmidt process

words.enDefinition: an orthogonal or unitary reflection that reverses one direction and fixes vectors orthogonal to it

examples.en: The Householder reflection sent the column onto the first coordinate axis after we selected its normal direction.
examples.zh: 我们选定法向方向后，「豪斯霍尔德反射」把该列向量映到第一坐标轴上。

examples.en: We used a Householder reflection to remove entries below the diagonal without changing lengths in the example.
examples.zh: 示例里，我们用「豪斯霍尔德反射」消去对角线下方的元素，同时保持长度不变。

collocations: compute QR factors with Householder reflections

words.enDefinition: an orthogonal transformation rotating two selected coordinate directions while leaving all other coordinates unchanged

examples.en: The Givens rotation combined two rows to make one unwanted entry below the diagonal zero in our calculation.
examples.zh: 我们的计算中，「吉文斯旋转」组合两行，使对角线下方一个不需要的元素变为零。

examples.en: We applied a Givens rotation after locating the two coordinates involved in that step of the factorization.
examples.zh: 我们找出分解这一步涉及的两个坐标后，应用了「吉文斯旋转」。

collocations: eliminate an entry with a Givens rotation

words.enDefinition: a QR factorization that permutes columns, often to reveal a useful ordering of independent directions

examples.en: The column-pivoted QR factorization exchanged two columns before placing the more informative direction first in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例里，「列主元 QR 分解」交换两列，使更有信息的方向放在前面。

examples.en: We used column-pivoted QR factorization to examine which columns could support a stable basis in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「列主元 QR 分解」查看练习表中的哪些列适合构造一组数值稳定的基。

collocations: estimate rank using column-pivoted QR factorization
inspect column order after a column-pivoted QR factorization

words.enDefinition: a cutoff below which singular values are treated as zero or omitted in a numerical calculation

examples.en: The singular value threshold removed a small direction that the measurements could not distinguish reliably from noise.
examples.zh: 测量无法可靠地区分一个很小的方向和噪声，于是「奇异值阈值」使该方向被滤除。

examples.en: We lowered the singular value threshold to see whether the reconstructed matrix changed by a noticeable amount.
examples.zh: 我们降低「奇异值阈值」，查看重建矩阵是否有明显变化。

collocations: choose a relative singular value threshold
test sensitivity to the singular value threshold

words.enDefinition: the difference between two successive ordered singular values, often used to judge separation of their associated directions

examples.en: The singular value gap after the second value helped explain why a rank-two approximation worked well in class.
examples.zh: 第二个奇异值之后的「奇异值间隙」有助于解释为什么秩二近似在课堂示例中效果好。

examples.en: We inspected the singular value gap before deciding whether the two largest directions were clearly separated.
examples.zh: 在判断最大的两个方向是否明显分离之前，我们检查了「奇异值间隙」。

collocations: identify a large singular value gap

words.enDefinition: decomposing a covariance matrix into orthonormal eigenvectors and eigenvalues giving variances along those directions

examples.en: The covariance eigendecomposition gave two directions whose coordinate scores were uncorrelated in the sample.
examples.zh: 「协方差矩阵特征分解」给出两个方向，在线性表示中，样本测量值沿这两个方向的变化不相关。

examples.en: We used the covariance eigendecomposition to compare the amount of variance captured by the first two directions.
examples.zh: 我们用「协方差矩阵特征分解」比较前两个方向各表示多少方差。

collocations: read variances from a covariance eigendecomposition

words.enDefinition: a difference separating selected eigenvalues, such as the gap between the largest and second largest under a specified ordering

examples.en: The spectral gap was small, so the tutor compared the two largest eigenvalues more carefully before interpreting them.
examples.zh: 「谱间隙」很小，因此导师在解读前更仔细地比较了两个最大的特征值。

examples.en: We reported the convention used for the spectral gap when comparing examples with negative and positive eigenvalues.
examples.zh: 我们比较包含正、负特征值的示例时，报告了「谱间隙」所用的约定。

words.enDefinition: a square matrix that is unchanged when multiplied by itself

examples.en: The projection in the exercise was an idempotent matrix because applying it twice returned the same projected vector.
examples.zh: 练习中的投影是一个「幂等矩阵」，因为应用两次会返回同一个投影后的向量。

examples.en: We tested whether the matrix was an idempotent matrix by computing its square and comparing the entries.
examples.zh: 我们求矩阵的平方并比较两者的元素，以检验它是否是「幂等矩阵」。

words.enDefinition: a square matrix some positive integer power of which equals the zero matrix

examples.en: The example nilpotent matrix had a nonzero square but became the zero matrix at the next power.
examples.zh: 示例的「幂零矩阵」平方不为零，但再取下一次幂就成为零矩阵。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why a nilpotent matrix could not have a nonzero eigenvalue in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师问为什么练习中的「幂零矩阵」不可能有非零特征值。

collocations: compute a power of a nilpotent matrix
show that a matrix is nilpotent

words.enDefinition: the smallest positive integer power that makes a nilpotent matrix equal to zero

examples.en: The nilpotency index was three because the square was nonzero but the cube vanished in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的平方不为零而三次幂为零，因此「幂零指数」为三。

examples.en: We determined the nilpotency index from the largest Jordan block associated with the zero eigenvalue in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据零特征值对应的最大若尔当块确定「幂零指数」。

words.enDefinition: similarity between two real square matrices expressed using an orthogonal change of basis

examples.en: The tutor verified orthogonal similarity by finding a real basis change whose inverse equalled its transpose.
examples.zh: 导师找出一项逆矩阵等于转置矩阵的实换基变换，以验证「正交相似」。

examples.en: We used orthogonal similarity to preserve both the eigenvalues and the geometry of the coordinate space.
examples.zh: 我们通过「正交相似」既保留特征值，也保留坐标空间的几何结构。

words.enDefinition: similarity between complex square matrices by conjugation with a unitary matrix

examples.en: We verified unitary similarity by checking that the change-of-basis matrix preserved complex inner products in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，我们核查换基矩阵能否保持复内积，以验证「酉相似」。

examples.en: The tutor used unitary similarity to show that the two matrices had the same singular values.
examples.zh: 导师用「酉相似」说明，两个矩阵具有相同的奇异值。

words.enDefinition: a relation obtained by transforming a bilinear form's matrix with an invertible matrix on one side and its transpose on the other

examples.en: We used matrix congruence to express the same real quadratic form in a different set of coordinates.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩阵合同」在另一组坐标下表示同一个实二次型。

examples.en: The tutor distinguished matrix congruence from similarity before comparing what changed in the two resulting matrices.
examples.zh: 导师在比较两个所得矩阵的变化之前，先区分了「矩阵合同」和相似。

collocations: diagonalize a form by matrix congruence

words.enDefinition: the counts of positive, negative and zero eigenvalues of a real symmetric or complex Hermitian matrix

examples.en: We recorded the inertia of a matrix to classify the signs represented in its quadratic form.
examples.zh: 我们记录「矩阵惯性」，据此判断其二次型可以取哪些符号。

examples.en: The tutor used a diagonal representation to find the inertia of a matrix in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师用对角表示求出练习表中的「矩阵惯性」。

collocations: compute the inertia of a matrix
determine the inertia of a matrix
compare the inertia of two matrices

words.enDefinition: the theorem that an invertible real congruence preserves the counts of positive, negative and zero eigenvalues of a symmetric matrix

examples.en: The tutor used Sylvester's law of inertia to explain why changing coordinates could not remove a negative direction.
examples.zh: 导师用「西尔维斯特惯性定律」说明，为什么换坐标无法消除使二次型为负的方向。

examples.en: We used Sylvester's law of inertia to test whether two diagonal matrices represented the same quadratic form.
examples.zh: 我们用「西尔维斯特惯性定律」比较两个对角形式，检查它们是否可能表示同一个二次型。

collocations: classify a form using Sylvester's law of inertia

words.enDefinition: an inner product constructed to give different weight to directions, for example by using a positive definite weight matrix

examples.en: The weighted inner product made the first coordinate contribute twice as much in the worksheet's alignment calculation.
examples.zh: 练习计算向量对齐程度时，「加权内积」使第一坐标的贡献变为两倍。

examples.en: We used a weighted inner product to compare the two signals after accounting for unequal measurement scales.
examples.zh: 考虑到测量尺度不同时，我们用「加权内积」比较两个信号。

collocations: derive a norm from a weighted inner product

words.enDefinition: the norm of the difference between a vector and its orthogonal projection onto a specified subspace

examples.en: The orthogonal projection error fell after we allowed the approximation to use one more direction in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，允许近似再使用一个方向后，「正交投影误差」减小了。

examples.en: We compared the orthogonal projection error for two candidate subspaces with the same dimension in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习表中两个维数相同的候选子空间对应的「正交投影误差」。
